# apicp_ssh_access (Resource)

Grants real SSH/SFTP login on an `apicp_web_domain`'s own Unix user, using a caller-supplied public key. Key-only — apicp never generates or stores a password for this, and never installs a separate FTP daemon; access reuses the node's existing sshd.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apicp_web_domain" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

resource "apicp_ssh_access" "example" {
  vhost_id   = apicp_web_domain.example.id
  public_key = "ssh-ed25519 AAAA... you@example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `public_key` (String) SSH public key (e.g. `ssh-ed25519 AAAA... comment`) authorized to log in. Changing this rotates the installed key in place.
- `vhost_id` (String) ID of the `apicp_web_domain` to grant SSH/SFTP access to. Changing this replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
- `unix_user` (String) The vhost's own Unix user this grant applies to — connect as `ssh <unix_user>@<node host>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apicp_ssh_access.example vh_abc123
```
